description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity responsible for setting up and managing geofences using Google Play Services. It initializes geofence objects, connects to GoogleApiClient, and handles geofence registration and connection callbacks.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages geofence setup, connection handling, and geofence registration for location-based alerting.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient, checks Google Play services availability, and creates geofences.

methods.name: createGeofences
methods.description: Creates and stores predefined geofence objects representing specific locations.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failures to connect to Google Play services, attempting resolution if possible.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback for successful connection to GoogleApiClient; initiates geofence registration.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of GoogleApiClient connection, removing geofences if necessary.

methods.name: isGooglePlayServicesAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether Google Play Services are available on the device.

methods.name: getGeofenceTransitionPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent to trigger GeofenceTransitionsIntentService upon geofence events.
